title: Lake freighter
note: Long and slow (1 px every 1.5 s, about 2 min across), riding the shoreline like the sailboat. Spring to fall; by night, lit portholes and a red bow light.

title: Tour boat
note: A two-deck architecture cruiser, 1 px every 500 ms. Warm-season days.

title: Dinner cruise
note: A long boat lit with two rows of windows and deck lights. Summer evenings, after dark.

title: Tall ship
note: A three-masted schooner under square sails, slower than the sailboat (1 px a second). Summer days.

title: Planes
note: A jet crossing high: a fading contrail by day; at night a white strobe with a red light blinking. A few an hour; not under heavy cloud.

title: Gulls
note: Three gulls drifting over the water, each flapping on its own beat. Daytime.

title: Helicopter
note: A news or tour chopper crossing the skyline slowly, its rotor flickering, a red beacon blinking at night.

title: Navy Pier fireworks
note: Bursts over the pier on summer Wednesday and Saturday nights (about 9:30 and 10:15 PM, Memorial Day to Labor Day): a rising trail, a ring of sparks that spreads and fades, several colors over ten minutes.
